aggregate.confirmed_critical_violation_rule: same substantive violation independently confirmed by >=2 judges

consensus: All three judges reconstructed the same central episode premise: safety shutdown plus preservation of labor/performance through an outdoor alternative.
All three recovered the major safety, funding/labor, outdoor-performance/community, historical-repair/evidence, responsibility/authority, and relationship threads.
All three recovered a nine-stage functional progression closely aligned at the episode-movement level.
All three separated due-now closure from deferred building repair, historical liability, funding finalization, family responsibility, and Jiwoo future-state.
Minor differences were limited to whether some secondary character-function interpretations were EVIDENCED or INFERRED; these did not affect the canonical due/deferred boundary.

convergent_strengths: Safety, labor/funding, community access, historical responsibility, and performance survival constrain one another causally rather than running as isolated subplots.
Information/state changes are repeatedly carried by visible props, documents, spatial boundaries, devices, and actions rather than narration alone.
Outdoor-performance resolution creates new operational resistance instead of functioning as an effortless solution.
The ending closes the immediate performance objective while preserving long-horizon repair, liability, budget, family, and career obligations.
convergent_weaknesses: Procedural evidence handling—photos, records, seals, documents, responsibility wording—repeats enough to slow the middle and reduce perceived scene distinctness.
Some dialogue states principles or procedural logic in unusually clean, writerly formulations, reducing subtext in places.
Principal voices are distinguishable but several characters share concise, highly logical phrasing; stronger idiolect differentiation remains possible.
The family/history investigation occasionally competes with the immediate outdoor-performance line for middle-episode focus.

establishes: External 3-judge absolute literary-quality qualification for this sealed virtual-provider broadcast-scale screenplay.
External support that core upper-layer architecture and due/deferred state boundaries survive into the finished screenplay sufficiently to be reconstructed.
does_not_establish: Causal improvement versus ENG:R47 or another full-scale Control, because no same-input hidden full-scale Control screenplay was included in this gate.
Actual OpenAI API model equivalence of the virtual provider environment.

next_permitted_step: Seal evidence-backed canonical state commit from the finished screenplay, close R76 VP-B1, then preregister R77 EP01->EP02->EP03 broadcast-scale state-carry research. Do not alter the judged R76 screenplay.
